props.name: error
props.description: Error to show under the field, e.g. from the server. Marks the field invalid and overrides the built-in checks while set.

props.name: onValidityChange
props.description: Fires when the field's validity changes, whether or not the error is showing yet.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Shows the error style. Same as passing aria-invalid.

props.name: completion
props.description: Suggests the rest of the text as ghost text once the caret is at the end, accepted with Tab or ArrowRight. Memoize async sources. Adding or removing it remounts the textarea, so keep it steady.

props.name: completionKeys
props.description: Keys that accept the suggestion. Defaults to Tab and ArrowRight.

examples.title: completion (Tab to accept)
